description: GLSUM: SUMMARIZE THE MONTH FOR THE GENERAL LEDGER
ON THE FIRST BUSINESS DAY OF A MONTH, AFTER THE DAILY BATCH,
POSTS EVERY POSTING OF THE MONTH THAT CLOSED TO THE GENERAL
LEDGER, AS STMTPRT PICKS THEM: ONE SIDE TO CUSTOMER DEPOSITS,
THE OTHER TO THE ACCOUNT THE CODE TABLE NAMES FOR ITS
TRANSACTION CODE. A CREDIT TO A CUSTOMER CREDITS DEPOSITS, A
DEBIT DEBITS THEM. WRITES EACH LEDGER ACCOUNT'S DEBITS AND
CREDITS FOR THE MONTH, AND REPORTS THEM.
EVERY TRANSFER'S LEGS POST ON ONE DAY, SO TRANSFERS IN TRANSIT
MUST NET TO ZERO OVER A MONTH. IF THEY DO NOT, A LEG WENT
MISSING, AND THE RUN ENDS WITH RETURN CODE 4.
RETURN CODES: 0 SUMMARIZED OR NO MONTH CLOSED,
4 TRANSFERS IN TRANSIT DO NOT NET TO ZERO,
16 AN UNKNOWN CODE OR ACCOUNT, OUT OF BALANCE,
1494-11-10 LP  EVERY DEBIT HAS ITS CREDIT: THE SUMMA, VENICE.

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: ACCRUAL-RECORD
records.description: ACCRREC: INTEREST ACCRUAL RECORD, 40 BYTES ONE PER ACCOUNT, IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER LIKE THE MASTER. INTEREST IS ACCRUED FOR EVERY CALENDAR DAY BEFORE THE THROUGH DATE, TO SIX DECIMALS, AND IS NEGATIVE FOR AN OVERDRAWN BALANCE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, ITS INTEREST BECOMES DUE, ROUNDED TO THE CENT; THE FRACTION STAYS ACCRUED. THE DUE MONTH IS ZERO ON THE DAYS NO MONTH CLOSES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 ORIGINAL VERSION.

records.name: AUDIT-RECORD
records.description: AUDITREC: AUDIT TRAIL RECORD, 100 BYTES, ONE PER POSTING THE AMOUNT IS SIGNED: CREDITS POSITIVE, DEBITS NEGATIVE.

records.name: GL-SUMMARY-RECORD
records.description: GLREC: GENERAL LEDGER SUMMARY RECORD, 60 BYTES ONE PER GENERAL LEDGER ACCOUNT, FOR A MONTH: THE DEBITS AND CREDITS THE MONTH'S POSTINGS MADE TO IT. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2004-03-15 TL  CR-0390 ORIGINAL VERSION.

records.name: WS-CLOSED-MONTH
records.description: THE MONTH THAT CLOSED AND THE ONE AFTER IT, AS IN STMTPRT.

records.name: GS-CODE-VALUES
records.description: CODETAB: TRANSACTION CODE TABLE FOR EACH TRANSACTION CODE, WHAT A STATEMENT CALLS IT AND THE GENERAL LEDGER ACCOUNT ITS POSTINGS MEET ON THE OTHER SIDE OF CUSTOMER DEPOSITS. COPIED WITH THE PROGRAM'S OWN PREFIX FOR THE :P: TAGS: COPY CODETAB REPLACING ==:P:== BY ==ST==. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2004-03-15 TL  CR-0390 ORIGINAL VERSION, FROM STMTPRT, FOR THE GENERAL LEDGER SUMMARY.

records.name: WS-LEDGER-COUNT
records.description: THE LEDGER ACCOUNTS, AND WHAT THE MONTH POSTED TO EACH.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: FIND THE MONTH THAT CLOSED, IF ONE DID, POST ITS POSTINGS TO THE LEDGER AND WRITE THE SUMMARY.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES, TAKE THE CLOSED MONTH FROM THE ACCRUALS AND START THE LEDGER AT ZERO.

paragraphs.name: 2000-POST-MONTH
paragraphs.description: POST THE POSTINGS OF THE CLOSED MONTH, AND THE INTEREST AND FEES POSTED FOR IT ON THE FIRST BUSINESS DAY OF THE NEXT.

paragraphs.name: 2100-POST-TO-LEDGER
paragraphs.description: POST ONE POSTING: DEPOSITS ON THE CUSTOMER'S SIDE, THE CODE'S LEDGER ACCOUNT ON THE OTHER.

paragraphs.name: 2200-FIND-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.description: FIND THE WANTED LEDGER ACCOUNT, AND POINT AT ITS TOTALS.

paragraphs.name: 3000-WRITE-LEDGER
paragraphs.description: WRITE A SUMMARY RECORD FOR EACH LEDGER ACCOUNT, AND CHECK THAT THE LEDGER BALANCES.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
